request: Owner: «эти иконки довольно странные, убери иконки, это показатель ИИ-слопа», then «Так я вроде сказал про ребрендинг иконок, давай делать, давай сделаем их в стиле той мозаики» — the Florentine pietra dura of the Instagram highlight covers (design/social/instagram/highlights/pietra-dura).
model: Higgsfield gpt_image_2_6, quality high, 1k, 1:1, transparent background (the model of the Instagram covers, so the stone matches)
template: A single round icon medallion in exactly the Florentine pietra dura style of the first/second reference: polished coloured stone inlaid into a DEEP GREEN marble disc, a thin terracotta(-and-gold) stone outer ring (with a fine gold inner line), fine seams between the stone pieces. In the centre one large simple motif in polished stone, about 60% of the disc: {motif}. No flowers, no leaves, no other ornament, only the motif on the green marble, so it reads clearly at 48 pixels. Front view, the disc centred and filling the square, transparent background outside the disc. Flat, even, soft light, no glare, no cast shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers.
processing: crop to alpha (>4 %) as a square plus 6 px; master WebP q92 in design/illustrations/source/mosaic/; site WebP q86 with alpha at 112 and 224 px (shown at 40–56 px, 2× screens take 224).
